title: cerastium pumilum var. petraeum
intro: Cerastium pumilum var. petraeum, commonly known as Alpine Sweet William or Rock Cress, is a flowering plant species within the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Cerastium pumilum var. petraeum include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which may help soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
